propositions: CLI route and capability architecture must be recorded in ADR 0100 before implementation begins, capturing the maintainer-approved design: immutable lazy-loaded registry, stdlib argparse as single grammar source, pre-operation help/routing, alias taxonomy, and semantic capability postures
Parser-derived help must be generated from the same argparse factory used at runtime, establishing it as the public compatibility boundary, with no separate docs DSL or unchecked syntax authority
ADR 0100 must explicitly prohibit plugin frameworks, Click dependencies, DI containers, middleware, and stored-data changes, and must not contradict RP-04 ADR 0098 routing boundaries

Generated artifacts (docs/adr/README.md, docs/adr/.numbers/0100, check_adr_numbers.py validation) must be byte-current and consistent, with only docs/architecture.md hand-edited to describe the implemented CLI boundary
